steps.speaker: [Vlog update time]
steps.content: 7:00 p.m., January 27, N.F. 113

steps.speaker: Reporter
steps.content: Welcome back to our special report! For those of you just tuning in, a giant monster appeared at 5 a.m. this morning and is wreaking havoc in Dillywood! Is it a Sinner? Is it Mania?

steps.speaker: Reporter
steps.content: The FAC has set up a blockade, but there seems to be no way of resolving this crisis anytime soon. The scene here is extremely terrifying. You can see its true face from this angle... Look...

steps.speaker: Apostle of Ashes S.T.
steps.content: Woosh...

steps.speaker: Reporter
steps.content: Th-the theater for the DisCars Awards Ceremony has been heavily damaged. It seems highly unlikely that this year's ceremony can take place as scheduled. This is a huge blow for film lovers all over the world!

steps.speaker: Reporter
steps.content: Why weren't we warned? How did this erupt all of a sudden? Who killed the 41st DisCars?

steps.speaker: Dean
steps.content: DisCars... My DisCars...
It's not over yet!

steps.speaker: Reporter
steps.content: Huh? What dashed by just now?

steps.speaker: Red Scarf Duck
steps.content:
Quack quack, quack!
(Everyone, assemble!)

steps.speaker: Timecop Duck
steps.content:
Quack!!
(Here!!)

steps.speaker: Rabbo
steps.content:
Quack quack quack quack, quack quack quack quack quack quack, quack.
(After countless hardships, we're finally on the battlefield! As soon as we terminate that Apostle of Ashes, all the twisted delusions will disappear.)

steps.speaker: Rabbo
steps.content:
Quack quack quack, quack quack quack, quack quack.
(This will also end our own existence, because we Timecops are born from someone's fleeting imagination.)

steps.speaker: Rabbo
steps.content:
Quack quack quack! Quack quack quack quack quack quack quack, quack quack!!!
(But I like this script! We were born to maintain the stability of space-time! Dying for it is the best ending we can have!)

steps.speaker: Rabbo
steps.content:
Quack! Quack quack?!
(That's my faith and conviction! What about you guys?)

steps.speaker: Timecop Duck
steps.content:
Quack!!!!!
(We're with you, Commander!)

steps.speaker: Rabbo
steps.content:
Quack quack! Quack quack quack, quack quack quack quack! Quack quack!!!
(All right, then! Line up, and charge! It's the final stage of Operation Stella Hunt! Terminate the Apostle!!!)

steps.speaker: Timecop Duck
steps.content: Quack... quack??

steps.speaker: [Black Screen]
steps.content: Before they can charge, a pair of pudgy little hands scoop them all up with a big, hollow container. They tumble all over inside.

steps.speaker: [Normal conversation. OwO's image appears.]
steps.content: OwO used her lion's head to catch them all!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Dumb ducks! You wanna become duck pie?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: That's a Starbeast who has lost its family! It's sad and angry. We can't use violence to solve this! Leave this to the real hero!

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: When we go back to edit, we need to add music to this part. Write that down.

steps.speaker: Daisy
steps.content: Huh? Oh, oh...

She flips her lion's head and flings the ducks far away from the battlefield. While the real target is still a distance away, many strange creatures have concretized into shape close by. Ironically, this does make it feel like a movie.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Whew... Is this the climax scene? I really do feel nervous and thrilled. Come here, Stella.

steps.speaker: Director" D
steps.content: Lynn, close-up!

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Ah, okay!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: We're sending you home!
D snaps her fingers, and you quickly add the explosion behind OwO.
